intro.subtitle: Shape your first agent, one step at a time.

step1.title: How did you hear about Stack32?
step1.subtitle: Please answer honestly — it helps us know which channels actually work.

step2.title: What best describes you?
step2.subtitle: Pick the closest match. We'll tailor Stack32 to your workflow.

step3.title: Tell us a bit about you
step3.subtitle: Your first name and public username, to personalize your workspace.
step3.usernameHint: Public agent links look like stack32.com/@username/agent-name. Choose carefully — this is how people find your agents.
step3.usernameInvalid: Use 3–30 characters: start with a letter, then letters, numbers, or underscores.
step3.phoneHint: Optional — choose your country code, then enter your number without the leading 0.
step3.useCase: What will your first agent do? (optional)
step3.useCasePlaceholder: e.g. Research prospects for my agency

username.settingsBody: A username is required to publish agents and share public links.

step4.title: Create your first workspace
step4.subtitle: A workspace groups your agents. You can create more later and switch between them anytime.
step4.point1: Keep personal and client projects separate
step4.point2: Each workspace has its own list of agents
step4.point3: Switch workspaces anytime from the sidebar

journey.goalTitle: What would you like your agent to help you achieve?
journey.goalSubtitle: Start with your goal. A few answers will turn it into a concrete first project.

goals.time: Save time in my daily work
goals.clients: Help my clients or my team
goals.sell: Create an agent to offer to subscribers

journey.ideaTitle: Do you already have an agent idea?
journey.ideaSubtitle: Your idea is the starting point. If you already entered it, it is waiting here.
journey.ideaPlaceholder: An agent that turns my notes into article drafts…
journey.ideaHint: Edit the suggestion before continuing. You will test it in the builder.
ideas: An agent that turns my notes into article drafts, with approval before publishing.
An agent that compares public information on a topic and prepares a summary with sources.
An agent that writes product descriptions from the specifications I provide.
An agent that summarizes meeting notes and prepares an action list for review.
journey.audienceSubtitle: A specific audience helps you build something useful.
journey.audiencePlaceholder: Me, my marketing team, small online stores…
journey.outcomeTitle: What would a successful first result look like?
journey.outcomeSubtitle: Choose a concrete result to test before trying to automate everything.
journey.outcomePlaceholder: An article draft ready for review, with three verifiable sources…
journey.summaryTitle: Your first project is taking shape
journey.summarySubtitle: Here is the starting point we will pass to the builder. You stay in control at every step.
nextSteps: Preview a personalized blueprint for your agent.
Choose its name and the subscription that fits your project.
Then build, test and approve it before publishing.
journey.disclaimer: A subscription provides the features of your selected plan. Results and potential earnings depend on your agent, testing and adoption; they are not guaranteed.
journey.error: We could not finish preparing your workspace. Your answers are saved; please try again.
journey.authTitle: Keep your idea. Create your space.
journey.authSubtitle: Your first answers are saved on this device. Create an account to prepare the next steps.

preview.title: Your idea is taking shape
preview.subtitle: We are arranging your brief into an initial agent blueprint.
preview.readySubtitle: Here is your agent’s starting point. Name it, then choose a subscription to start building and testing it.
preview.diagramLabel: Proposed blueprint: brief, instructions, tools, output and review
preview.localNotice: Animated preview prepared on this device. No agent or AI model runs at this stage.
preview.paymentNotice: A paid subscription is required to continue. Monetization is available with Pro or Scale. Tools will be validated and authorized during the build.
